_calibration_notes: THIS LANE EXISTS FOR ONE REASON: three operators -- `runway` over a burn plan, `inverse_change`
for a pair of measures reciprocal by definition, and `implied_base` -- are covered offline by
hand-written proposals only. Nothing else shows the MODEL proposing them from a real deck, and
a model that never proposes an operator makes the operator dead code however well it is tested.
TWO KINDS OF ASSERTION, kept apart on purpose:
- What the model proposed (`proposed_operators_required`, `runway_proposed_with_schedule`),
read from the Step 3.7 hand-off (`handoff/<run_id>/relations_output.json`). These ARE the
test; a failure names the operator the proposer skipped.
- What the engine decides once those are proposed. Verified offline through the real
`reconcile.build()` over a ledger built from this deck's own sentences
(test_lane_numeric_checks.py runs it free on every suite):
runway over the plan: $3.1M against $120K/month for Jan-Dec 2027 then $2.4M/year from
Jan 2028 = 20.3 months, against a stated 44 -> contradiction. Counting the $3.65M raise as
cash gives 38.55 months, still a contradiction, so the raise is no way out.
inverse_change: a 35% reduction in cost per claim = a 53.8% increase in claims per dollar,
against a stated 12% -> contradiction (the pair is the engine's `cost per` / `per dollar`
table row; outside the table a disagreement is never reported).
implied_base: $1.1M at 5% implies about $19.1M-$25.6M -> a derived reading, never a
finding, so it is asserted as PROPOSED only; whether it surfaces depends on select()'s cap
of three derived readings and on the label the extractor writes, and is printed instead.
flat path: $3.1M / $120K a month (25.8 months) and $3.1M / $2.4M a year (15.5 months)
against the same 44 are both retired as `superseded` by the runway over the plan, because
both burns are the plan's own segments. `flat_runway_ratio_never_beside_runway` checks the
founder-visible half (no such ratio survives beside the runway); the superseded count is
printed, since it is zero when the model simply did not propose a flat division.
The engine half still depends on the extraction (labels, periods, units), so a proposed operator
that does not surface is diagnosed rather than guessed at: the lane replays the engine over the
run's own ledger, second read and proposals and prints each target relation's verdict and the
engine's stated reason.
numeric_findings_min 2 follows from the two required surfaced contradictions; it is the coach's
half of the same claim.
score_pct and overall_status ranges copied from the contradiction lane (same slide count, same
kind of deck); never measured on this fixture. Re-derive both from the first two runs.
Kestrelline is fictional. No real founder or company data. Figures invented for this fixture.
